policy_restated: Record the exact models and configurations actually exposed by the current account before delegation. Instantiate the strongest configurations repeatedly where independent cognition is useful. Never use Auto where an exact frontier model can be selected and logged. Do not optimise downward for token or monetary cost during this window. A weaker configuration is admissible only after a frozen paired evaluation demonstrates a functional advantage for that work class.
observation_discipline: Exposure was enumerated from the delegation surface this runtime actually presents, not from documentation. Documentation-named families that this surface does not expose are recorded NOT_SUPPORTED with the observed boundary rather than assumed available or silently substituted.

lead_binding.evidence: cursor-cloud run-info reported originalModelName claude-opus-5-thinking-max for run bc-e92c4fa6-3658-4270-ab36-9eb56bf2ed20.

allocation.rationale: The commission names this family for strongest results and for the integrator role. The controller writes shared control state and ingests every subordinate result; it produces no counted work unit of its own so that it never grades its own production.

Custody engine, portable runtime and successor generations are the highest-consequence engineering surfaces, so the commission's strongest engineering default is instantiated three times rather than once.

allocation.role: independent chief challenger and parallel engineering
allocation.commission_default: gpt-5.6-sol at the highest exposed reasoning setting
allocation.rationale: xhigh is the highest gpt-5.6-sol reasoning setting exposed here, so high and high-fast were not selected. Fault injection, PO-01 qualification and zero-base challenge are the work classes where disagreement with the lead family is most valuable.

allocation.commission_default: gemini-3.1-pro at its highest exposed setting
allocation.rationale: The commission's named default for this role is not exposed on this delegation surface. Rather than manufacture availability, the duty was reassigned to the highest exposed setting of a third distinct family so that heterogeneity remains grounded in observed exposure.
Measurement is a distinct work class from production, and separating it from the producing families reduces the chance that a producer's framing sets its own denominator.

allocation.role: blind adversarial review of Claude-produced work
allocation.commission_default: at least two different frontier model families for consequential review
allocation.rationale: A fourth distinct family reviews the Claude-produced cohorts. high is the only gpt-5.6-luna setting exposed, so no higher setting was declined.

cross_family_review_matrix.rule: A reviewer never shares a model family with the producer it judges, and freezes its criteria before receiving producer conclusions.
cross_family_review_matrix.coordinator_reviewed_by: po03-worker-a10 (claude-sonnet-5-thinking-xhigh), a different family from the coordinator's claude-opus-5 binding

not_supported.observed_boundary: This runtime's delegation surface exposes no Gemini slug, so no Gemini worker can be instantiated or logged. The family's availability in provider documentation is not evidence of exposure to this account's delegation surface.
not_supported.mitigation: Role reassigned to claude-sonnet-5-thinking-xhigh and gpt-5.6-luna-high, preserving three-plus family heterogeneity from observed exposure.

not_supported.observed_boundary: No composer slug is exposed on this delegation surface.
not_supported.mitigation: None required. The commission admitted composer only as a distinct harness hypothesis or on a preregistered matched-evaluation advantage, so its absence removes a hypothesis rather than capability.

cost_measurement_state: Cost and token telemetry availability is being probed by cohort a7 under unit a7-u04. If the runtime does not expose it, a7 records NOT_SUPPORTED with the exact boundary. No cost figure is estimated anywhere, and cost is never used as an automatic downgrade rule.

context_admission.policy: Bounded, hashed source capsules with measured context admission. Highest reasoning does not license indiscriminate context dumping.
context_admission.implementation: Each subordinate receives its frozen dispatch record plus a named, hashed source set from wave-a-spec.json source_hashes, rather than the whole tree. Whether capsules outperform whole-tree admission is itself a preregistered hypothesis under unit a5-u04, so the policy is tested rather than assumed.

repeated_instantiation_of_strongest_conf.note: Strongest exposed configurations are instantiated repeatedly where independent cognition is useful, as the commission requires, rather than once each.

per_model_contribution_and_disagreement: NOT_YET — computable only after dispositions land. Cohort a7 unit a7-u06 computes it per exact model slug from committed dispositions, with no attribution to Auto.
